notes: SEC Section 31 effective dates are charge-date based: each advisory applies to covered sales on charge dates on or after the effective date.
Rate in force on 2014-01-01 was $17.40/M (set 2013-05-25, FY2013 Advisory #3); confirmed unchanged by FY2014 Advisories #2 and #4.
No-mid-year-adjustment confirmations fetched for FY2015, FY2016, FY2020, FY2021, FY2023: one rate change per fiscal year; the table captures every effective date from 2014-01-01 forward.
FINRA TAF: SEC Rel. 34-90176 states TAF rates had not increased since 2012, confirming no equity/option TAF changes 2012-07-01 through 2021-12-31.
Options TAF first row (2014-01-01, $0.002) is a window-start anchor: the rate predates 2014 (TAF adopted 2002); its original effective date was not verified and is intentionally not stated.
2025 had no TAF change: SR-FINRA-2024-019 lists 2025 as no-change from 2024 rates.
As of 2026-08-10 FINRA's static Schedule A page still displayed 2024-2025 rates; 2026-01-01 rates verified from SR-FINRA-2024-019 Exhibit 5C and FINRA's Fee Adjustment Schedule page.
All entries compiled 2026-08-10 by fetching the cited primary sources.
